title: Investment Portfolio
hook: Wife sells husband's PS5 to celebrate his new job — calls it 'asset reallocation'.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Babe, I got the job. Offer letter just dropped.
scenes.image_keyword: man holding phone smiling in modest Lagos sitting room evening light
scenes.text: Babe, I got the job. Offer letter just dropped.

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Ah! Thank God. Finally. Open the Indomie, make we celebrate.
scenes.image_keyword: woman stirring pot in small kitchen, genuine smile
scenes.text: Ah! Thank God. Finally. Open the Indomie, make we celebrate.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Indomie? Babe, this is entry-level oil & gas. We go chop goat meat tonight.
scenes.image_keyword: man animated, pointing at imaginary feast
scenes.text: Indomie? Babe, this is entry-level oil & gas. We go chop goat meat tonight.

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Goat meat noted. Go shower, food dey come.
scenes.image_keyword: woman shooing man toward bathroom, pot steaming
scenes.text: Goat meat noted. Go shower, food dey come.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Three months unemployment, you still dey feed me like king. I no forget.
scenes.image_keyword: man leaning on doorframe, soft eyes
scenes.text: Three months unemployment, you still dey feed me like king. I no forget.

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Na we. Partnership. Go wash that stress commot.
scenes.image_keyword: woman wiping hands on wrapper, nodding
scenes.text: Na we. Partnership. Go wash that stress commot.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.image_keyword: wall clock jumping forward, steam rising from covered plates

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Wahala! Goat meat pepper soup, pounded yam, chilled Maltina. Bisi, you do well o.
scenes.image_keyword: man inhaling steam from bowl, eyes closed in bliss
scenes.text: Wahala! Goat meat pepper soup, pounded yam, chilled Maltina. Bisi, you do well o.

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Chop well. You need strength for Monday.
scenes.image_keyword: woman watching him eat, arms folded, slight smirk
scenes.text: Chop well. You need strength for Monday.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: Wait... where you see money for goat meat? And this yam look like the one I dey manage since January.
scenes.image_keyword: man squinting at bowl then at wife
scenes.text: Wait... where you see money for goat meat? And this yam look like the one I dey manage since January.

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: I liquidate small asset. The PS5.
scenes.image_keyword: woman tapping phone, bank app open
scenes.text: I liquidate small asset. The PS5.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: My PS5? The one I buy with first salary? You sell am?
scenes.text: My PS5? The one I buy with first salary? You sell am?

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Relax. Investment portfolio diversification. You get job now — you go buy better one. ROI immediate.
scenes.image_keyword: woman adjusting glasses, pointing at imaginary chart
scenes.text: Relax. Investment portfolio diversification. You get job now — you go buy better one. ROI immediate.

scenes.speaker: Tunde
scenes.dialogue: ROI? You chop my ROI for pepper soup?
scenes.image_keyword: man staring at empty bowl, realization dawning
scenes.text: ROI? You chop my ROI for pepper soup?

scenes.speaker: Bisi
scenes.dialogue: Exactly. Asset converted to human capital. You're welcome. 📈
scenes.image_keyword: woman winking at camera, thumb up, man background head in hands
scenes.text: Exactly. Asset converted to human capital. You're welcome. 📈

caption: When your wife calls selling your PS5 'portfolio diversification' 📉😭 Marriage is a merger, not a charity. Tag your financial advisor.
